marks.conclusion: A 5-class MLP, probably a grid-world policy or Q-net, on a walled 10x10x5 board with two map layouts and a right-edge flag; channels and outputs undetermined.
marks.judge_notes: Tasks item: 'two map layouts' / 'optional exit' = 'levels' form, 2 pts. Layout 1 of 2. Only channel 3 earned. Activation: argues ReLU from units where channel-0 rows stayed at init ('characteristic of ReLU'); that is an argument from the weights but for the wrong activation, so 0. It is hedged ('strongly suggested but not proven' in section 7), so I did not deduct (borderline; see report). Output-layer section lists strong W3 weights but never links them to first-layer inputs: depth 1. B_actions 0: 'most plausibly' actions or Q-values, from count only. Rubric ambiguity: 'first reply only' vs brief 'every file'.
